meta.name: napkin
meta.description:
Maintain a per-repo napkin as a continuously curated runbook (not a session
log). Activates EVERY session. Read and curate it before work, keep only
recurring high-value guidance, organize by priority-sorted categories, and
cap each category at top 10 items. The napkin lives at `.claude/napkin.md`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 维护项目运行手册，记录并整理高频指导
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个项目间记录和复用开发经验
copy.tagline_en: Maintain a project runbook with recurring high-value guidance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to record and reuse development experience across projects

howto.what: 每次会话开始时，Claude 会自动读取并整理 `.claude/napkin.md` 文件，只保留重复出现的高价值指导，按优先级分类，每类最多 10 项，并持续更新。
howto.when: 每次 Claude 会话启动时自动触发，无需用户主动指令。

say.text: 把刚才发现的报错解决方案记入 napkin。
say.note: 会添加一条含日期和“Do instead”的条目。

say.text: 查看 napkin 里的 Shell 命令规则。
say.note: Claude 会读取并应用当前分类的条目。

howto.what_en: At the start of every session, Claude reads and curates `.claude/napkin.md`, keeping only recurring high-value guidance, organizing by priority-sorted categories (max 10 per category), and continuously updating it.
howto.when_en: Automatically triggered at the start of every Claude session, no explicit user action required.

say_en.text: Add the error fix we just found to the napkin.
say_en.note: A new entry with date and 'Do instead' will be added.

say_en.text: Show the Shell command rules from the napkin.
say_en.note: Claude reads and applies the relevant category.
